summary: New Fortress Energy Inc. filed an 8-K announcing UK High Court approval to convene creditor meetings under a previously disclosed consensual UK Restructuring Plan. The plan is a formal restructuring support agreement (RSA) with creditors, aimed at reorganizing debt through a UK scheme of arrangement. No financial terms (price, stake, premium) are stated. The company is implementing the plan, not conducting a sale or change of control. Next step: creditor meetings and vote deadline June 9, 2026. This is not a standard M&A or activist event—it is a court-supervised restructuring process.
